title: Nhanda language
extract: Nhanda, also rendered Nanda, Nhanta and Nhandi, is an Australian Aboriginal language from the Midwest region of Western Australia, between Geraldton and the Murchison River, from the coast to about 20 kilometres inland. The language is now spoken, or semi-spoken, by only a few people.
